summary: Example of a self-service portal template auto-generated from a job template, part 1: namespace default, name lowercased with hyphens, title and description copied, labels as tags, job template URL as annotations, a hidden token field (AAPTokenField) and a Prompt on launch inventory using AAPResourcePicker.
questions: What does an auto-generated self-service template look like?
How does the self-service portal turn a job template into a template?
